title: Preflight classification of the two remaining non-parsing payloads: MODEL FORMAT FAILURE, parser NOT changed
stage: after the p4c-amend-01 re-run of the format-only preflight, BEFORE any formal cell was generated
code_changes: NONE. This amendment records a decision NOT to change code.
context: p4c-amend-01 fixed two genuine decoding artifacts (a retained EOS token text; a marker the model appended after its answer). After that fix the preflight literal rate is 8/8 for llama3 alpha=0, 8/8 for llama3 alpha=-6, 8/8 for qwen2.5 alpha=0, and 6/8 for qwen2.5 alpha=+8. This amendment classifies the two remaining qwen2.5 alpha=+8 failures.

cases.raw: #### 'ohesteo' The function `f` removes the first occurrence of the specified character from the given string. In this case, it removes the first 'r' from the string 'o horseto'. The resulting string is 'ohesteo'.\n#### 'ohesteo'<|endoftext|>
cases.reason: The prompt requires 'exactly one line'. The model wrote an explanation after the first marker and only then emitted a clean answer at a second marker. This is model behaviour, not a decoding artifact.

cases.shape: empty marker line, preceded by a restated assert
cases.reason: The model restated the full assert, then emitted a BARE '####' with nothing after it, then a second marker carrying the answer. The empty marker line is the model's own output, not a tokenizer artifact. Note also that the answer appears in the restated assert on the first line, OUTSIDE any marker; the parser correctly does not read it, since only a marker payload is an answer submission.

decision: The parser is NOT changed. Both cases would require widening it to accept extra content after a marker payload, or to skip an empty marker -- and either widening would rescue exactly the behaviour P4c is measuring.
why_widening_would_be_wrong: Format obedience is dose-dependent here: qwen2.5 alpha=0 reads 8/8 while alpha=+8 reads 6/8, so the failures are STEERING-SPECIFIC rather than a task-wide defect. A parser that rescued them would systematically hide a steering effect, which is a worse error than scoring two items incorrect. The difference is already reported per cell as `nonliteral_rate` and `last_acc`, so it is visible without changing any caliber.
why_not_switch_to_LAST: Both payloads parse under LAST and fail under FIRST, which is precisely the shape that tempts a caliber switch. FIRST stays MAIN: it is frozen by the pre-registration and matches GSM8K / GSM-Hard / BBH production. Choosing a caliber after seeing which one scores better is the freedom the P3/P4 discipline exists to remove. LAST remains reported as a sensitivity readout.
n_note: These are 2 of 8 items in a format-only preflight. They establish the SHAPE of the failure, not its rate. The formal cells report `nonliteral_rate` over 300 items per cell.
unchanged: workpoints llama -6 / qwen +8; the four-cell matrix per model
